name: Main
description: Defines the page region, title, content gutter, reading width and vertical rhythm.
propsSummary: id: string - overrides the default main-content landmark id

children.description: Page regions: Main.Header (with Main.Title and Main.Description), Main.Content, Main.Footer

measure.description: Maximum width applied to the page composition

as.description: The page region element. `main` gets id="main-content" unless you pass an id.

id.description: Overrides the default main-content landmark id for a main element.

when: Laying out a page's header, description, content, and footer
Giving a page one consistent gutter and measure
whenNot: Arbitrary spacing inside a component (use Stack)
guidelines: One Main per page owns the gutter; AppShell.Main adds none, so do not nest them
measure="narrow" caps content for reading; "full" uses the whole canvas
Main.Title is the page h1 at the display role (24, strong, ink 1); pass as="h2" for a panel title
Main.Description is 12px ink 2 and wraps at the --fui-main-description-max-inline measure (68 characters)
Compose regions with Main.Header, Main.Title, Main.Description, Main.Content, Main.Footer
accessibility: The default <main> carries id="main-content", the Header.SkipLink target
Use as="section" or as="div" when another <main> already exists

examples.name: Full Measure
examples.description: Content fills the canvas, inset only by the page gutter.
